retry.automaticTransientRun: Automatic transient retries are append-only run records inside the same jobAttemptId and same approval subject. They never create a new jobAttemptId, never change receiptSubjectKey, never skip a gate, and never carry an approval across changed evidence/IR/runtime/output digests.
retry.retryableErrorEntryRule: Only RENDERING or ASSEMBLING may enter RETRYABLE_ERROR as a visible persisted state; PREPARING retries loop within PREPARING run records and cannot jump to QUEUED before READY and current gates exist.
retry.manualRetry: Manual retry after terminal FAILED or T5_REJECTED creates a new jobAttemptId in PREPARING, links previousAttemptId and retryReason, and requires fresh T1-T5 decisions for that new subject. No T1-T5 receipt from the old attempt is valid for the new attempt.
retry.t5Rejection: T5 rejection terminalizes the attempt as FAILED/T5_REJECTED; any follow-up is manualRetry with full reapproval unless a new immutable T4 predecessor for the new attempt is produced. Renderer success and media QC never create or carry approval.

t5.approve: in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE append receipt, recheck lease/version/authz/deletion epochs, promote staged refs, set COMPLETED
t5.reject: append reject receipt; set FAILED with safe code T5_REJECTED; a new render attempt requires current T4
t5.cancelPolicy: ASSEMBLING and AWAITING_T5 are not cancellable; cancellation is accepted only in PREPARING, QUEUED, or RENDERING and acknowledged at the next safe boundary

gateDecision.reject: append immutable reject receipt; retain evidence; return to the state immediately before the rejected boundary except T5, which follows t5.reject
gateDecision.correction: new immutable evidence/IR version and decisionVersion; never mutate a receipt
gateDecision.invalidation: an invalidator at gate N transitively marks N and every approved successor through T5 stale; earliest stale gate blocks progress
gateDecision.assignments: only super-admin may create or revoke reviewer assignments. Job-scope assignments require tenantId and gate T1-T5. Release-scope assignments require releaseId, gate T6 and tenantId=null. The assignee cannot assign itself, and one assignment cannot authorize both scopes.
gateDecision.t6: release-scoped only; subjectId is releaseId, reviewer authorization comes from a release-scope T6 assignment with tenantId=null and no X-Tenant-Id request header, predecessorId is the immutable release baseline manifest digest, and evidence must reference at least one T5-approved pilot receipt chain without treating tenant T5 receipts as release-scope predecessors

quarantineRelease.terminalRecordRule: QUARANTINED remains terminal and immutable. A release command never mutates that upload into ACCEPTED and never returns an accepted artifact reference.
quarantineRelease.linkedRevalidationAttempt: Authorized release creates a new uploadSessionId linkedReleasedFromItemId, state VALIDATING, same tenant, same source bytes copied into sandbox-only staging, and a new validationAttemptNo. It must rerun magic-byte, size, ffprobe, duration/fps/rotation, disk-admission and normalization checks before it can independently become ACCEPTED.

outcomes.acceptedAfterRevalidation: new linked upload reaches ACCEPTED and emits UPLOAD_FINALIZED plus QUARANTINE_RELEASE_REVIEWED
outcomes.failedAfterRevalidation: linked upload reaches INPUT_INVALID or QUARANTINED and emits QUARANTINE_RELEASE_REVIEWED with outcome=blocked
outcomes.reject: original quarantine remains retained/rejected and emits QUARANTINE_RETAINED

forbidden: read quarantined/raw bytes outside the media sandbox
reuse old quarantine validation as acceptance

authz.bff: BFF service credential is audience-bound to session:introspect only; each forwarded call carries opaque sessionId; API resolves user, selected tenant, capabilities and epochs server-side
authz.requestRule: re-read active tenant, membership and all epochs on every request; stale epoch is AUTHZ_EPOCH_STALE
authz.memberRemoval: increment membership epoch, revoke member sessions and bearer tokens, deny new downloads and claims
authz.tenantSuspension: increment tenant epoch, revoke tenant sessions/tokens, pause queued claims, stop active work at next stage boundary, deny download issue and serve; preserve immutable history

paths./geometry/*: finite canvas coordinates x 0..1080 y 0..1920 w 1..1080 h 1..1920
paths./owners/*: existing ownerId or one current choice polygon <=64 vertices
paths./passOrder: permutation of existing allowlisted pass IDs

irPatch.saga: validate If-Match -> create candidate AuthoringIR -> transitively stale affected gates -> compile linked SceneIR and BrowserPassSpec -> render preview -> atomically set candidate current and return ETag; on any failure retain prior current chain and return EDIT_COMPILE_FAILED

order: BEGIN IMMEDIATE and recheck lease/version/authz/deletion/restore epochs
insert staged or published DB reference
publication.recovery: discard staging; sweep unreferenced CAS after grace; any DB reference without a matching object is fatal CAS_INTEGRITY_ERROR
publication.backup: drain claims -> safe boundary -> WAL checkpoint TRUNCATE -> snapshot DB -> record and snapshot CAS manifest -> write backup manifest
publication.restore: new isolated root only -> verify all digests -> increment restore epoch -> revoke sessions/tokens/leases/downloads -> preserve deletion epochs -> fixed-frame verification -> T6

evidenceIndex.singleWriter: verification/blackbox/evidence-writer.mjs obtains an exclusive lock and rejects parallel writes with EVIDENCE_WRITER_BUSY
evidenceIndex.rule: attempt-local evidence is indexed here; F1-F4 consume this canonical index and verify every referenced digest, output artifact digest, and Chrome/Playwright browser identity

authorityExtensions.todo3VerifierRoot: After Todo 3 freezes verification/contract-lock.json, it emits an externally anchored verifier root that records parentRootSha256, contract-lock SHA, black-box verifier script digests and forbidden-import scan digest. F1 requires it.
authorityExtensions.releaseManifest: Todo 45 emits a T6-bound immutable release manifest enumerating final OpenAPI, runtime manifest, model manifest, handoff zip, recovery report, final media/report digests, Playwright browser identity and evidence index tail SHA. T6/F1 require it.
authorityExtensions.rule: No child/root extension may rewrite parent entries; extensions append child manifests that preserve parentRootSha256 and are consumed by final verification.

composeIsolation.qaAuditEgress: separate one-shot verifier with no appnet/database/CAS mounts; outbound HTTPS only to registry.npmjs.org; writes hash-bound advisory JSON to .omo/evidence for offline qa verification
composeIsolation.rule: no docker compose run --network flag; qa may reach only appnet services; compiler/worker/preflight external DNS and IP probes must fail; live dependency audit never runs inside isolated qa
